exams.name: AP Art History
exams.blurb: AP exam built around 250 required works of art from global cultures, testing visual analysis, contextual knowledge and comparative essay writing.

exams.name: AP Biology
exams.blurb: College-level AP exam covering cellular processes, genetics, evolution, ecology and experimental design, scored 1 to 5 for possible college credit.

exams.name: AP Calculus AB
exams.blurb: AP exam equivalent to a first-semester college calculus course, covering limits, derivatives, integrals and the fundamental theorem of calculus.

exams.name: AP Calculus BC
exams.blurb: Extended AP calculus exam covering all Calculus AB topics plus parametric, polar and vector functions, sequences and series, with an AB subscore.

exams.name: AP Chemistry
exams.blurb: AP exam equivalent to first-year college chemistry, covering atomic structure, bonding, kinetics, thermodynamics, equilibrium and acid-base reactions.

exams.name: AP Chinese Language and Culture
exams.blurb: Computer-delivered AP exam assessing Mandarin listening, reading, speaking and writing at roughly the fourth-semester college level.

exams.name: AP Comparative Government and Politics
exams.blurb: Fully digital AP exam comparing the political systems of China, Iran, Mexico, Nigeria, Russia and the United Kingdom through six core course countries.

exams.name: AP Computer Science A
exams.blurb: AP exam in object-oriented programming taught in Java, covering data types, control structures, classes, arrays, recursion and algorithm analysis.

exams.name: AP Computer Science Principles
exams.blurb: Broad AP computing exam combining an end-of-course digital test with the Create performance task submitted through the AP Digital Portfolio.

exams.name: AP Drawing
exams.blurb: Portfolio-based AP assessment in drawing and mark-making where students submit a sustained investigation plus selected works for external scoring.

exams.name: AP English Language and Composition
exams.blurb: Fully digital AP exam in rhetorical analysis, argument and synthesis writing, widely accepted as first-year college composition credit.

exams.name: AP English Literature and Composition
exams.blurb: Fully digital AP exam on close reading of poetry, prose fiction and drama, with three free-response essays including a literary argument.

exams.name: AP Environmental Science
exams.blurb: Interdisciplinary AP exam covering ecosystems, biodiversity, populations, energy resources, pollution and global change from a scientific perspective.

exams.name: AP European History
exams.blurb: AP exam covering European history from about 1450 to the present, including a document-based question and a long essay on historical reasoning.

exams.name: AP French Language and Culture
exams.blurb: AP exam assessing French interpretive, interpersonal and presentational communication with recorded speaking tasks at intermediate-high proficiency.

exams.name: AP German Language and Culture
exams.blurb: AP exam assessing German listening, reading, speaking and writing through authentic materials and recorded responses across six themed units.

exams.name: AP Human Geography
exams.blurb: Introductory AP exam on population, migration, culture, political geography, agriculture, urbanisation and economic development patterns.

exams.name: AP Italian Language and Culture
exams.blurb: AP exam measuring Italian proficiency across listening, reading, speaking and writing, including recorded conversation and cultural comparison tasks.

exams.name: AP Japanese Language and Culture
exams.blurb: Computer-delivered AP exam testing Japanese listening, reading, speaking and writing, including kanji recognition and typed character input.

exams.name: AP Latin
exams.blurb: AP exam requiring translation and analysis of set passages from the Aeneid of Vergil and the Gallic War of Caesar, plus sight reading.

exams.name: AP Macroeconomics
exams.blurb: AP exam covering national income, inflation, unemployment, fiscal and monetary policy, and international trade at introductory college level.

exams.name: AP Microeconomics
exams.blurb: AP exam covering supply and demand, elasticity, production costs, market structures, factor markets and market failure at college introductory level.

exams.name: AP Music Theory
exams.blurb: AP exam combining written harmony and analysis with aural skills, melodic and harmonic dictation, and recorded sight-singing performance tasks.

exams.name: AP Physics 1: Algebra-Based
exams.blurb: Algebra-based AP exam covering kinematics, forces, energy, momentum, torque, simple harmonic motion and fluids for a first college physics course.

exams.name: AP Physics 2: Algebra-Based
exams.blurb: Algebra-based AP exam covering thermodynamics, electricity and magnetism, optics, and modern physics as a second-semester college course.

exams.name: AP Physics C: Electricity and Magnetism
exams.blurb: Calculus-based AP exam covering electrostatics, conductors and capacitors, circuits, magnetic fields and electromagnetic induction.

exams.name: AP Physics C: Mechanics
exams.blurb: Calculus-based AP exam covering kinematics, Newtonian mechanics, work and energy, momentum, rotation, oscillations and gravitation.

exams.name: AP Precalculus
exams.blurb: AP course and exam launched in 2023 covering polynomial, rational, exponential, logarithmic, trigonometric and polar functions and modelling.

exams.name: AP Psychology
exams.blurb: Fully digital AP exam covering biological bases of behaviour, cognition, development, social psychology, mental health and research methods.

exams.name: AP Research
exams.blurb: Second AP Capstone course assessed entirely by a 4000-5000 word academic paper, presentation and oral defence rather than a timed written exam.

exams.name: AP Seminar
exams.blurb: First AP Capstone course scored from team and individual research performance tasks plus a written end-of-course exam on source analysis.

exams.name: AP Spanish Language and Culture
exams.blurb: Most-taken AP world language exam, assessing Spanish listening, reading, writing and recorded speaking at intermediate-high proficiency.

exams.name: AP Spanish Literature and Culture
exams.blurb: AP exam on a required reading list of Peninsular, Latin American and US Hispanic literature, with analysis and essays written in Spanish.

exams.name: AP Statistics
exams.blurb: AP exam covering exploratory data analysis, sampling and experimental design, probability and statistical inference, requiring a graphing calculator.

exams.name: AP United States Government and Politics
exams.blurb: AP exam on US constitutional foundations, branches of government, civil liberties, political behaviour and required Supreme Court cases.

exams.name: AP United States History
exams.blurb: Fully digital AP exam covering US history from 1491 to the present with a document-based question and long essay testing historical reasoning.

exams.name: AP World History: Modern
exams.blurb: AP exam covering global history from about 1200 CE to the present, emphasising comparison, causation, continuity and change across regions.
